name: Ginath
overview: Ginath is a male biblical figure identified primarily as the father of Tibni, mentioned in 1 Kings 16:21. Beyond this familial connection, Scripture does not provide additional details regarding his tribe or other personal attributes. His role is noted briefly without further elaboration in the biblical narrative.
namesAndTitles: The name Ginath is a proper name meaning "protector." This meaning may reflect a characteristic or hoped-for quality but is not explicitly connected to his biblical role. The name was not given directly by God, as indicated in the biblical record.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Ginath as the father of Tibni, establishing a direct paternal relationship. No other family connections or relationships are documented beyond this link in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Ginath's significance in the biblical narrative arises chiefly through his son Tibni, who appears in the context of Israel's royal history in 1 Kings. Though Ginath himself is not a central figure, his mention establishes a genealogical line important for understanding the political dynamics of the time. His brief mention underscores the biblical emphasis on lineage and heritage in the unfolding of God's providential plan.
